title: Shusha Hotel & Congress Centre
description: A five-star hotel and congress centre in the historic heart of Shusha, with 154 rooms, Azerbaijani cuisine, spa facilities, and event spaces.

title: Cidir View Guesthouse
description: A warm guesthouse close to Cidir Plain, ideal for travellers who want quiet mornings and wide valley views.

title: Kalbajar Mountain Lodge
description: A peaceful alpine lodge near Istisu springs with comfortable rooms and direct access to mountain routes.

title: Christy Hotel Shusha
description: A characterful stone hotel in Shusha with warm interiors, a quiet setting, and easy access to the historic centre.

title: Shusha Heritage Walk
description: A guided walk through Shusha's historic streets, viewpoints, music heritage, and remarkable architecture.

title: Lachin Valley Route
description: A full-day mountain journey through green valleys, forest paths, and quiet riverside viewpoints.

title: Istisu Springs Day Trip
description: A restorative day around Istisu's mineral springs, highland scenery, and local stories.

title: Khankendi Cultural Route
description: A relaxed cultural route connecting city landmarks, local food, and the surrounding Karabakh landscape.

title: Isa Bulagi Restaurant
description: A scenic Shusha restaurant and istirahət kompleksi serving local flavours beside the historic Isa Bulagi spring.

title: Susa Qala Restaurant
description: A welcoming stone-built restaurant for Azerbaijani cuisine, tea, and a relaxed meal near Shusha's cultural landmarks.
